title: Spot the difference: classroom
prompt: Three things changed between the two classroom pictures. Which list names all three changes?
explanation: Compare the two pictures bit by bit: The red crab changed colour from orange to red, the orange changed colour from orange to plain and the red ladybug vanished. Nothing else is different.
